answer: To combat Sybil attacks, we implement Slashing Reputation Escrow. First, every agent must lock $10,000 in collateral. Second, they embark on a long voyage of verified computations to build a trust score. Third, any detected malicious behavior triggers an immediate, permanent loss of those funds. An attacker faces a cost of $500,000 in bonds and 90 days of strict verification. At the dawn of our decentralized era, this rigor ensures only honest actors thrive. This mechanism is like a grand, ancient mesa, standing tall and unmovable against the chaotic winds of identity fraud.
